# Pip Explains

Read [the repository production instructions](../AGENTS.md) before episode, scene, storyboard, cover or brand work. The authoritative visual standard and approved reference are in [pip-brand-standards.md](../docs/studio/pip-brand-standards.md); use its full labelled stage strip where it helps navigation (it need not fill every body shot; see **Presentation flexibility**, 24 October 2026) and a dedicated takeaway ending, with topic-specific labels and animation.

For content strategy, scripts, hooks and profile copy, read [the shared marketing context](../.agents/product-marketing.md). Keep brand decisions in the authoritative standard rather than editing installed generic marketing skills.
